svg.title: Query side — any replica answers alone, even with the owner down (US116, US218, US219, GET by id)

g.text: Query side — any replica answers alone, even with the owner down (US116, US218, US219, GET by id)
sort (most recent first), cut the page
GET /api/maintenance-records/{id of a record owned by replica 2}
503 Service Unavailable (only the owner may change the record)
Assignment 1: the same GET asked the peers over HTTP; a stopped replica made its records invisible (404)
and lists partial (X-Partial-Response: true). Assignment 2: no peer call on reads.
